title: Frozen mod
description:
❄️ Frozen Mod

Explore icy biomes, fight Frozen Slimes & Zombies, craft Fraznite gear, and uncover frozen secrets!

Compatible with NeoForge 1.21.8.
body: ❄️ Frozen Mod Enter a world of ice and adventure! Frozen Mod adds icy biomes, a new dimension, and frosty mobs to Minecraft. Features: Explore the Frozen Biome in the overworld and venture into the mysterious Frozen Dimension. Encounter Frozen Slimes and Frozen Zombies guarding treasures and chilling the land. Collect Fraznite Ore and craft Frozen Tools and Armor to survive the cold lands. Build and decorate with new frozen blocks: Frozen Logs, Planks, Stone, Bricks, and Reinforced Snow. Discover secrets in Ruined Snow Portals and icy dungeons. Frozen Mod is a survival and adventure mod bringing icy exploration and new challenges to Minecraft. Compatible with NeoForge
